Subject: SOC 2 Type II report & trust portal access — next steps

Hi Jordan,

Great speaking with you earlier — thank you for the time and for walking us through Acme Health's integration timeline. As discussed on the call, two quick follow-ups from our side to keep the procurement/security track moving: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report: Can you confirm whether you have the 2025 Type II available to share, or if you'll be granting access via your trust portal?

2) Bridge letter: If the Type II doesn't cover the period you need, would a bridge letter be possible (we can share a template if helpful).

3) Vendor security questionnaire: Please let me know who I should loop in for the questionnaire. If useful, we can start with a short set of answers (SOC 2 scope, data processing, retention, encryption).

Next steps: If you can either attach the report or provide trust portal access, we can move forward with procurement. Targeting to have security review complete by end of next week if possible.

Thanks — attaching a short checklist for our security team to speed things up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jordan — that works. A couple clarifications/questions from security on our side: 

• Scope: Our security team will want to confirm whether the SOC 2 scope includes third-party hosting and any dedicated/private deployment controls (we ran through Hosted vs Dedicated on the call).
• HIPAA: Acme indicated HIPAA applicability — can you confirm whether the Type II report or the DPA explicitly covers HIPAA-covered data processing? If not, a BAA or DPA addendum would be ideal.
• Bridge letter: If you could upload a short bridge letter covering Jan–Jun 2026 until the next Type II is available that would speed procurement. We have a one-page bridge template we can share if helpful.

Also, for trust portal access: read-only access to the portal is preferred (so our security team can download artifacts). If you can share an invite link or the admin contact, I’ll pass it along to our security reviewer (Rishi).

If you upload the report and bridge letter tomorrow as mentioned, we’ll start the internal review and let Procurement know the go-ahead. Thanks again.

Best,
Marissa
